text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Well, that's my shopp'n taken care of. Time t'get back and train!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: …Now that I'm look'n around, though, the city sure does have a lotta tall build'ns.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Morioka's noth'n but mountains and rice fields. The only tall structures 'round are those transmission towers…

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Good golly, how many floors does that one even have? It looks about as big as Tokyo Tower.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: W-wait a sec! That one's even bigger! And the one next to it's a whopper too!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: …And I got so set on find'n the tallest build'n that I went and lost track of time.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: I'm really sorry for miss'n training!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She seems genuinely remorseful, so I decide to let her off with a warning to be more careful.
